prompts.image: Use case: sketch-to-render / photorealistic-natural. Create ONE final live-action film still, 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Input 1 is a WORKING BLENDER RENDER, strictly a camera, spatial layout, scale and composition reference, NOT the final visual style. Input 2 is a SMALL PERSPECTIVE/BLOCKING GUIDE of the same camera: its converging lines explain real spatial directions and its primitive figures mark human placement. Do not reproduce the guide, linework, captions, faceted bodies, plastic surfaces or crude geometry. Rebuild the visible scene as a convincing photographed physical place while retaining the prescribed viewpoint, major dimensions, openings, object positions and framing. Improve natural material variation, construction details, contact shadows and realistic light; do not redesign the layout or invent different architecture. No game-engine look, no illustration, no split panels, no watermark. Early-1990s provincial Polish atmosphere, understated cinematic realism and restrained film grain, no modern products. Input 3 is the exact production identity and wardrobe reference: Dariusz is the chubby red-brown wavy-haired boy with rectangular dark glasses on the LEFT of that reference; Owczar is the slim dark-blond boy in the burgundy track jacket on its RIGHT. Both are 13–14, clean-shaven. Preserve their specific faces, hair, age, body shape and clothing. Owczar has TWO cream stripes on each sleeve, ivory T-shirt, loose blue jeans and worn pale canvas trainers. Dariusz has an open grey-blue plaid overshirt, grey/navy striped T-shirt, dark loose jeans and dark worn trainers. Their positions in the final shot are dictated by the shot instructions, not by the identity reference layout. Replace all visible primitive stand-ins with anatomically natural boys, and insert the boys where requested even if the clean render is empty. No adult beard, no extra people. SHOT ACTION AND COMPOSITION: Camera looks toward the boys from immediately in front of the CRT. Dariusz screen LEFT, Owczar screen RIGHT. Both gaze at the game just beneath the lens, not posing for a photo. Owczar focused and slightly tense, Dariusz anticipating the outcome. Their faces lit by the CRT; hands below frame. Dim, close, slightly hazy basement arcade, motivated warm practical lights mixed with soft CRT illumination. Retain real cabinet artwork and its physical shapes. Exposure must keep faces readable where present; believable darkness, not uniformly bright room.  Input 4 is the completed opening shot: use it only to preserve the same physical cabinet finish, practical lighting and photographic treatment. Do not copy its viewpoint or body placement; the first two geometry references define THIS camera.
prompts.animation: 0.0–1.0s: Owczar on screen right is already following the offscreen game just below the lens; his brows tighten and his upper body makes a small forward pulse. Dariusz on screen left watches the same point, lifting his eyebrows with anticipation. 1.0–2.0s: Owczar briefly presses his lips together and eases back a few centimeters; Dariusz gives a small encouraging nod without looking away from the game. 2.0–3.0s: Both regain concentrated expressions, still watching the screen. Camera: locked at CRT height. Subtle changing CRT light reflects on their faces and glasses. @Image1 fixes only their facial identities, hair and ages; preserve Start Frame clothing, arcade lighting and background. No speaking, looking into camera, extra people, facial morphing, cuts or slow motion.
